title: relayer-http operator
description: Is the service answering, and which KMS node is slow or failing: from the metrics. The service over the selected range on top, then one section per flow, never mixed; open it on an alert (monitoring/design.md, Dashboards).

options.content: OperatorLookupClient stats

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: relayer-http alerts firing now (monitoring/alerts.yaml), from Prometheus' ALERTS series. Click for the list.

panels.title: Internal errors
panels.description: Requests answered `internal` in the range, every flow: a relayer defect (an internal error or a panic). Any is a bug. Click to list them in the lookup.

panels.title: Signer errors
panels.description: Failed attempts to sign a connector call in the range: the signing key (AWS KMS) unreachable or refusing.

panels.title: KMS nodes failing
panels.description: KMS nodes with more than half of their attempts failing in the range for a reason that blames the node, every flow: the RelayerHttpKmsNodeFailing alert's exclusions.

panels.title: Requests by flow
panels.description: Requests answered in the range, by flow; `none` is a request answered before its flow was known (unknown route or method).

panels.title: Call slot wait p95
panels.description: Time an attempt waited for an outbound call slot over the range, every flow. Rising while KMS node latency is flat: the pod is saturated, scale out.

panels.title: Public decrypt: requests
panels.description: Public decrypt requests answered in the range, every outcome.

panels.title: Public decrypt: outcomes
panels.description: Public decrypt requests by outcome in the range: succeeded 2xx, rejected 4xx, failed 5xx, cancelled (the client closed the connection first). Click to list the failed ones in the lookup: it searches the text "flow":"public_decrypt","outcome":"failed", which relies on the two fields being adjacent in the summary line (endpoint/summary.rs).

links.title: Failed public decrypts in the lookup

panels.title: Public decrypt: succeeded
panels.description: Succeeded ÷ (succeeded + failed) for public decrypt: the share the relayer served. Rejected requests (client errors, 4xx) and abandoned ones are left out; the outcomes tile counts them.

panels.title: Public decrypt: latency p50
panels.description: Receipt to answer over the range; client errors and abandoned requests left out.

panels.title: Public decrypt: latency p95
panels.description: Receipt to answer over the range; client errors and abandoned requests left out. The slow request alert fires at 0.8 x the call timeout.

panels.title: Public decrypt: time spent after threshold
panels.description: Share of the answered public decrypt time spent after the threshold was reached, over the range: total wait over total latency (client errors and abandoned requests left out). The aggregation still collects until every KMS node finished or the deadline passed; this is the latency added for safety. A ratio of totals, exact unlike a ratio of percentiles.

panels.title: Public decrypt: requests by outcome
panels.description: Answered public decrypt requests per second, by outcome (succeeded 2xx, rejected 4xx, failed 5xx, cancelled).

panels.title: Public decrypt: error codes
panels.description: Public decrypt requests answered with an error, by API error code.

panels.title: Public decrypt: latency
panels.description: Receipt to answer (client errors and abandoned requests left out).

panels.title: Public decrypt: wait after threshold
panels.description: Seconds from reaching the threshold to the answer: the aggregation still collects until every KMS node finished or the deadline passed. p50 is the usual cost of waiting for every share, p99 the slow-node tail. A rise usually means one slow KMS node: see KMS node health.

panels.title: Public decrypt: KMS node health
panels.description: One row per KMS node over the range. error %: failed attempts that blame the node, over attempts (the RelayerHttpKmsNodeFailing alert's exclusions). p95: attempt latency. tries/call: 1 is no retry. cut: attempts the relayer cut in flight (deadline, fail fast, client hangup); a node often cut is too slow to count. Click a node for the requests it failed or was cut from (the lookup searches its name as text: names that are prefixes of each other, such as kms-1 and kms-10, would match each other).

targets.expr: sum by (kms_node) (increase(relayer_http_kms_attempt_errors_total{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node", code!~"malformed|unsupported_attestation_type|acl_denied|user_signature_rejected|user_decryption_expired|ciphertext_not_found|unprocessable|cancelled|panic"}[$__range])) / sum by (kms_node) (increase(relayer_http_kms_attempts_sum{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (kms_node, le) (increase(relayer_http_kms_attempt_duration_seconds_bucket{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__range])))

sum by (kms_node) (increase(relayer_http_kms_attempts_sum{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__range])) / sum by (kms_node) (increase(relayer_http_kms_attempts_count{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__range]))

value.title: Requests this node failed or cut

panels.title: Public decrypt: attempt latency p95 by KMS node
panels.description: One HTTP round trip to the node's connector: no slot wait, no backoff. Cancelled attempts (cut at the deadline or by fail fast) are included: a hung node shows as slow.

panels.title: Public decrypt: failed attempts by KMS node and code
panels.description: One series per KMS node and connector error code; `cancelled` is an attempt cut in flight (a hung node, or fail fast).

panels.title: Public decrypt: KMS nodes over time
Public decrypt: attempts per call by KMS node
panels.description: Mean attempts one node call took: 1 is no retry.

targets.expr: sum by (kms_node) (rate(relayer_http_kms_attempts_sum{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kms_node) (rate(relayer_http_kms_attempts_count{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Public decrypt: attempt error ratio by KMS node
panels.description: Failed attempts that blame the node or the path to it, over attempts made, per KMS node. The same exclusions as the RelayerHttpKmsNodeFailing alert.

targets.expr: sum by (kms_node) (rate(relayer_http_kms_attempt_errors_total{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node", code!~"malformed|unsupported_attestation_type|acl_denied|user_signature_rejected|user_decryption_expired|ciphertext_not_found|unprocessable|cancelled|panic"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kms_node) (rate(relayer_http_kms_attempts_sum{flow="public_decrypt", instance=~"$instance", kms_node=~"$kms_node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Public decrypt: cut calls by KMS node
panels.description: Attempts the relayer cut in flight, per KMS node and second: at the deadline, by fail fast, or at a client hangup.
